name: Smart Grid / Energy Systems Engineer
description: Develop software for smart grid systems, energy management, and power electronics control. Implement protocols like IEC 61850 and DNP3.
example_snippet:
program SmartMeter:
    shape MeterReading holds:
        Timestamp as whole number
        Voltage as fractional number
        Current as fractional number
        Power as fractional number
        EnergyConsumed as fractional number
    end shape

    action calculate_power takes M as const ref MeterReading produces fractional number:
        produce success with the product of M.Voltage and M.Current
    end action

    keep Reading as MeterReading with 1234567890 and 230.0 and 5.0 and 0.0 and 1000.0
    keep Power as fractional number
    call calculate_power with Reading giving Power
    print the text "Power: " and Power and " W" and newline
end program
status_note: dictum_net.c, dictum_file.c, dictum_timer.c, dictum_signal.c implemented. Grid protocol stacks (IEC 61850, DNP3) require C imports.
